item.title: Vele returns on Whoyostro with ‘No Love Lost’ - Data Transmission
item.description: Vele steps up on Whoyostro with ‘No Love Lost’, out 8th May, and this one comes straight from the source.

item.title: Fede Spamer goes deep on ‘Late Night Visions’ EP - Data Transmission
item.description: Fede Spamer’s ‘Late Night Visions’ EP arrives as a self-release on 10th April 2026, and it comes built for the darker end of the room.

item.title: CrucifyMe drops his debut Evolution Chamber EP ‘Coloured Starshow’ - Data Transmission
item.description: CrucifyMe makes his full debut on Evolution Chamber with 'Coloured Starshow', a 6-track EP that moves across registers

item.title: The Disco Ball Crisis Nobody Talks About - Data Transmission
item.description: There’s a moment every DJ knows. The lights drop. The booth warms up. The dancefloor locks in. And above it all sits the disco ball doing its job. Tiny mirror tiles throwing light across the room. Walls flickering, faces glowing, that proper club magic. But here’s the thing. Disco balls have been struggling. After years […]

item.title: Andrew Meller fires up Adesso Music with the tough and trippy ‘Work’ - Data Transmission
item.description: Andrew Meller is back on Adesso Music on 3rd April 2026, and this new double A-side means business. After closing out 2025 on Junior Jack’s label with ‘Groovin’ / Dance To The Rhythm’, the Serbian producer returns with ‘What We Need / Work’, two cuts built with the floor firmly in mind.

item.title: Lizzie Curious, Charlie Big and Shanie lock into peak-time form on ‘Rub Ah Dub’ - Data Transmission
item.description: Lizzie Curious, Charlie Big, and Shanie lock into peak-time form on ‘Rub Ah Dub’, landing 3rd April via Nuhope Entertainment

item.title: Crusy's New Groove is Here - Data Transmission
item.description: Get ready to boogie your socks off! Toolroom is serving up a delightful treat from Crusy that captures the nightlife spirit with a cheeky wink.

item.title: X-Korp lands on Murmuration Records with ‘Zulutron / Anti-Rave’ - Data Transmission
item.description: Murmuration Records presents X-Korp ‘Zulutron / Anti-Rave’, a groove-led Neurofunk release built for the dancefloor.

item.title: Journey Through My Discography: RILEY (UK) - Data Transmission
item.description: RILEY maps his journey from ‘Going Deeper’ to ‘Falling Deep’, tracing key releases, defining moments and his evolving sound.

item.description: Toxin links with Thunda Banton on ‘SoundBoi' EP, blending Jungle energy with Dancehall flavour across four heavyweight cuts...

item.title: Renegade Riddims: Dj Twista - Data Transmission
item.description: Dj Twista is one of those names that’s been woven into the fabric of UK rave culture for decades. Over 25 years deep and still moving with purpose!

item.title: Chico Rose (NL) &amp; Baggi hit Hottrax with the club-ready ‘Beep Beep’ - Data Transmission
item.description: Chico Rose (NL) and Baggi land on Hottrax for the first time on 3rd April 2026 with ‘Beep Beep’, and it does exactly what you want a record with that title to do.

item.title: Emma B hits TSHA’s Jackfruit with club-ready double header ‘Call The World / Viciosa’ - Data Transmission
item.description: Emma B lands on TSHA’s Jackfruit imprint this week with her new two-tracker ‘Call The World / Viciosa’, out April 3.
